content.text:
Restart note: you reloaded every window on 2026-10-12 at 13:36 AWST. Test whether the status bar follows the focused Claude tab when you switch sessions in the same workspace.

One conflict first. Since 2026-09-18 we don't polish a Squarespace site in place, so the offer is a rebuild off Squarespace. Per your copy rule, treat the draft below as options for you to pick from, not final lines. Bracketed parts are placeholders for facts to confirm on the walk-in, not invented.

**Walk-in offer (5 sentences, spoken):**

1. "I looked at [gym name]'s site before coming in, and three things stood out: [defect 1, e.g. the class timetable is hard to read on a phone], [defect 2], and [defect 3]."
2. "Those come from the template Squarespace puts you in, so no amount of tweaking inside it fixes them for good."
3. "What I do instead is build you a new site from scratch, in the look you'd choose, and host and look after it, so you stop paying for the builder and its add-ons."
4. "Your members would see a faster site with your timetable, trial or booking link, and photos front and centre."
5. "I can put a mock-up of your gym on a link for you to look at, with nothing to sign, and you can tell me if it's worth a second chat."

**Before you say it:**
- Check each defect on the real site at 390px width, so the three are true.
- Keep any prices out of the opener, and keep the pitch free of urgency lines.
- "Hosts and looks after it" matches your ruling that care is not optional on any tier.
- Sentence 5 assumes you'll build a demo first, as in `/prospect-to-pitch`.

If the gym is an existing client (e.g. Engine Room Fitness), this pitch doesn't apply.
